synthetic_data.description: All study data are synthetic demand streams generated per run from documented parameters and seeds (research/protocol.md section 3; generator src/fare/streams.py). Streams are regenerated from their seed keys and identified by SHA-256 in every result file; no stream data are stored separately.
synthetic_data.seed_scheme: numpy SeedSequence(entropy=20261124, spawn_key=(experiment, cell, role, index)); role 0 = tune, 1 = eval
